	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"

// scenario for gorm_model_hook_contains_external_io: Hooks that call HTTP clients, queues, file I/O, or external side effects.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type Rule064PositiveRecord struct {
	ID       int

	Name     string
}

func (u *Rule064PositiveRecord) AfterCreate(tx *gorm.DB) error {
	resp, err := http.Get("https://example.com/webhook?action=created&id=" + string(rune(u.ID)))
	if err != nil {
		return err

	defer resp.Body.Close()
	_, _ = io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	return nil
}
